newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA SEES HIGHER BAD DEBT EXPENSES.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA SEES HIGHER BAD DEBT EXPENSES.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday that it expected higher bad debt expenses in the current 1997/98 (July/June) year.
"There will be an upturn in bad and doubtful debt expenses, but our general provisioning is very good," managing director David Murray told reporters.
The bank earlier on Wednesday issued its 1996/97 (July/June) profit result which showed a fall in bad and doubtful debts to A$98 million from A$113 million a year earlier.
Murray said the economy appeared finally to have reached the trough of the bad debts cycle.
"I think that this year it might have hit rockbottom," he said.
